Setup2FA.title: Set up two-step verification
Setup2FA.intro: It is required to protect client information. You need an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, 1Password, etc.).
Setup2FA.scanHelp: Open your authenticator app and scan this code.
Setup2FA.qrAlt: QR code for the authenticator app
Setup2FA.manualKey: Can't scan? Enter this key manually:
Setup2FA.backupHelp: Each code works once if you lose access to your app. Keep them somewhere safe: they will not be shown again.
Setup2FA.backupSaved: I saved my backup codes somewhere safe

users.title: Users
users.subtitle: Create accounts, assign roles, deactivate access and link each assistant to the agents they support. Users are never deleted: they are deactivated.
users.confirmBody: {assistant} will immediately stop seeing the clients of {agent}. The change is written to the audit log.

toast.passwordReset: Password reset. Their sessions were closed.
toast.deactivatedMoved: Account deactivated. {clients} clients and {reminders} reminders were reassigned.

form.createDescription: Hand over the initial password in person. On first sign-in the user must change it and set up 2-step verification.
form.name: Full name
form.roleSelfHint: You cannot change your own role.

roleHelp.ADMIN: Full access: users, settings, export and import.
roleHelp.AGENT: Their own clients: details, coverage, doctors, medications, notes and reminders.
roleHelp.ASSISTANT: Clients of their linked agents: contact, notes and reminders. No medical information or full identifiers.

form.toAssistantWarning: An assistant has no clients of their own. {count, plural, one {Their client} other {Their # clients}} will move to the agent you choose. Their links as an agent are deactivated.
form.fromAssistantWarning: When they stop being an assistant, their links to agents are deactivated.

security.title: Account and security
security.resetPasswordBody: Type a temporary password and hand it over in person. All their sessions will be closed and they must change it on sign-in.
security.resetTwoFactorBody: For a lost phone. Their setup and backup codes are deleted, their sessions are closed and they must set it up again on sign-in.
security.deactivateBody: They will not be able to sign in and their sessions are closed immediately. Their history is kept.
security.deactivateWork: They have {clients} clients and {reminders} pending reminders. Choose which agent receives them; each change is recorded in the client's history.
security.reactivateBody: They will be able to sign in again with their current password. Reassigned clients do not return automatically.
security.selfNote: Change your own password in My account. You cannot deactivate yourself or reset your own 2FA.

carriers.title: Carriers & programs
carriers.subtitle: Turn on the programs each carrier offers. Only active carriers with an active relationship appear when recording coverage.
carriers.noLinks: No relationships configured yet. No carrier will appear when recording coverage until you turn on at least one program.

rules.title: How it works
rules.r1: No relationship is assumed: you decide what each carrier offers.
rules.r2: You can add ACA-only carriers without mixing them with Medicare or Medicaid.
rules.r3: Deactivating a carrier or a relationship does not delete existing coverage; it just stops being offered for new records.
rules.r4: Every change is written to the audit log.

audit.subtitle: Read-only security log: sign-ins, denied access, revealed identifiers, exports and administration changes. It never contains health data or identifiers. Viewing it is also recorded.

DataTransfer.title: Import / Export
DataTransfer.subtitle: Load clients from a file or download your list as Excel or CSV.

export.title: Export clients
export.body: Download the clients you can see, with their contact details and, if you have access, their current coverage.
export.bodyFiltered: The {count, plural, one {# client} other {# clients}} in the list with the current filters will be exported.
export.fromList: To export only part of the list, filter the client list and use its Export button.
export.masked: Medicare, Medicaid and member numbers are exported masked (•••• 1234).
export.sensitive: Include full identifiers (Medicare, Medicaid, member number)
export.sensitiveWarning: The file will contain protected health information. Store it only on protected devices, do not email it unencrypted and delete it when no longer needed. The export is logged.
export.sensitiveConfirm: I understand and want to include them
export.done: File downloaded ({count, plural, one {# client} other {# clients}}).

import.title: Import clients
import.body: Upload a CSV or Excel file with one row per client. Personal and contact details are imported; coverage, doctors and medications are added later in each profile.
import.rules: Up to 2 MB and 2,000 rows. First name and Last name columns are required. Headers may be in English or Spanish.
import.confirm: Import {count, plural, one {# client} other {# clients}}
import.noneValid: There are no valid rows to import. Fix the file and try again.
import.result: {imported, plural, one {# client was} other {# clients were}} imported. {skipped, plural, =0 {} one {# row was not imported.} other {# rows were not imported.}}
